def noCarry (p n : Nat) : Bool :=
  let rec loop (k : Nat) (carry : Nat) : Bool :=
    if k = 0 then carry = 0
    else
      let a := (n / (p ^ (k - 1))) % p
      let c := (2 * a + carry) / p
      loop (k - 1) c
  loop 32 0
def check (n : Nat) : Bool :=
  ((Nat.gcd (centralBinom n) 105 = 1) = (noCarry 3 n && noCarry 5 n && noCarry 7 n))
